title: feat(scripts): derive the `body`-dialect producer table from a SCAN under a written criterion
body:
Part of #9871

⚠️ **`Part of`, ⛔ not `Fixes` — changed from `Fixes` by the `domain:ui#2` execution seat at 2026-09-18T19:06Z (clock read by this write), ⛔ not by the dev.** The code deliverable here is complete and independently landable, but this card also carries a question the dev handed back under 回翻条款: **is an `item`-carried `body` inside objectui#6771's ruled family?** Triage ⛔ forbade splitting that question into a third card — 「⛔ 不该再拆出第三张」 — so it has to stay on objectui#9871, and an auto-close would take it off the board with the question unanswered. The seat moves the card to the decision box after this merges.

⭐ **The first deliverable is the CRITERION, not another count.** This PR adds no
entry to a list. It writes down what counts as a producer of the `body`
child-list dialect, and makes the table an ANSWER to that criterion, computed on
every run.

## The criterion

`scripts/body-dialect-producer-scan.mjs` — stated in its header, emitted by
every run in both output modes, and pinned in
`scripts/__tests__/body-dialect-producer-scan.test.ts`. A site is a producer iff
**C1 and C2** hold; **C3** is the axis the answer is filed under.

- **C1 — EMISSION.** The site causes the literal key `body` to appear in
  metadata a party OUTSIDE this tree then owns. Channels: `default-props`,
  `scaffold`, `snippet`. ⭐ A channel is recognised by a KEY PATH or by an
  EMISSION VERB in the enclosing function — ⛔ never by a file name, which would
  be the enumeration this scan replaces, one level up.
- **C2 — RESOLUTION.** Some reader in this tree resolves a `body` off that
  carrier INTO A CHILD LIST. ⭐ The reader set is DERIVED per run, never listed:
  a registration that starts or stops resolving `body` joins or leaves it by
  itself. C2 is APPLIED, not merely derived — it held 313 shipped-source `body`
  spellings out of the table on this branch, and the count is PRINTED so the
  drop is never silent.
- **C3 — CARRIER.** `node` (a `BaseSchema` node — objectui#6771's ruled family),
  `item` (a member of a declared item array — ⛔ UNRULED, see below), or `string`
  (written into the author's document; the carrier is theirs, so the scan
  reports no family disposition rather than guessing one).

⛔ Excluded, each machine-readable and emitted beside the reading: a
DECLARATION (`inputs: [{ name: 'body' }]`, a published type member) teaches the
spelling and writes nothing; a READER consumes rather than emits; a `body` no
derived reader resolves fails C2; authored corpus and teaching are the dialect's
VICTIMS, bucketed apart and never summed in.

## The two blindnesses, closed — each proven by ablation

The census declares both limits, so ⛔ this is not a bug report against it. They
are the two directions a classifier keyed on "object with a string-literal
`type`" is PERMANENTLY blind in.

- **B1** — no sibling `type` is required. `type` is recorded as a carrier FACT,
  of ANY value. A `body` directly under `defaultProps` is node-carried even with
  no sibling `type`, because the node is the registration and its `type` is the
  registered key — requiring a sibling there is B1 again one frame up, and it is
  the shape objectui#7181's three `defaultProps` producers had.
- **B2** — string and template literals are READ. One `scanSource` pass from the
  shared masker (`scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs`, ⛔ never a private stripper),
  projected twice: comments-and-literals blanked for the structural walk,
  comments-only blanked for the key sweep. The `literal` flag is then what tells
  a code key from a spelling inside a string.

## Measurements — my own corpus, ⛔ not inherited

Read on `origin/main` `f5e2fcb4a16ae1b80b81db1dc890399c01a58c6a` at
**2026-09-18T18:20Z** (⚠️ the dispatch named `02bc27b08` as the tip; it had
moved). Producer table on this branch: **6 sites**, `pnpm census:body-dialect-producers`.

| file:line | carrier | channel | disposition |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/tabs.tsx` 88 / 89 / 90 | item | default-props | `unruled:item-carrier` |
| `packages/vscode-extension/src/providers/CompletionProvider.ts` 108 / 133 / 146 | string | snippet | `carrier-undetermined` |

Both sites re-verified at source. ⚠️ Two corrections to the dispatch: the
snippet string is at **146**, not 145 — 145 is the `if` that guards it; and the
same scan resolves a **third item-carrier reader** the card does not mention,
`packages/components/src/renderers/data-display/list.tsx` drawing each entry as
`item.content || renderChildren(item.body)`.

⭐ The shipped `tabs` `defaultProps` item FAILS its own published item contract.
Measured against the built `TabItemSchema`, with a lit control in the same
command: the shipped item `{ label, value, body }` gives
`invalid_type ["content"] expected nonoptional, received undefined`, while the
same item spelled `content` parses green with keys `value, label, content`.

### Ablation — mutate, prove by blob hash, run, restore, prove by hash equality and an empty `git diff HEAD`

⭐ Each leg is taken on a value the two implementations DISAGREE about, ⛔ not on
the headline value. Baseline 6 producers at `ccad335e5`, scanner blob
`6211cdc04c9f`.

| leg | mutation | predicted | OBSERVED |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `carrierOf` requires a sibling `type` (the census's rule) | item carriers vanish | **6 → 3**, the three `tabs` rows gone |
| 2 | literal-key sweep INVERTED | target gone | **6 → 8** — target gone AND three duplicates, the guard does two jobs |
| 2b | literal-key sweep DISABLED | `literal-key-syntax` gone | **6 → 5**, `CompletionProvider:146` gone |
| 3 | key-name-datum sweep disabled | those two gone | **6 → 4**, `CompletionProvider:108/133` gone |
| 4 | leg 1's mutation, running the census test file | the re-pointed block REDS | **1 failed / 21 passed**, by its own message |

Leg 2 is reported as observed rather than as predicted: inverting the guard made
the sweep re-score code-position keys the frame walk already had, so the
direction was mixed. 2b is the clean form and both are kept.

Every leg restored: blob back to `6211cdc04c9f` and `git diff HEAD` empty.

## ⚠️ The family question is HANDED BACK, ⛔ not answered here

Is an `item`-carried `body` inside objectui#6771's ruled family? The scan files
it `unruled:item-carrier` and REFUSES to fold it into the ruled total. Answering
it would EXTEND a ruled family rather than apply one, so 回翻条款 applies and it
returns to the decision box. The measurements behind that, each taken here:

- `TabItem` declares `content` REQUIRED and declares no `body`; `ListItem`
  declares `content` optional and no `body`. Neither published face — TS or Zod
  — carries the key at all, so step 3 ("retire `body` from the published type")
  has no subject on the item face.
- #6771's remedy is "`children` is the one spelling". The item face's canonical
  child-list key is `content`, ⛔ not `children`, so step 2's remedy names a key
  the item face does not have.
- Both item reads reach `body` only through an `any` cast
  (`(item as any).body` in `tabs`, `items.map((item: any) …)` in `list`).
- objectui#9256 filed the ITEM channel SEPARATELY and pinned it LIVE on purpose:
  *"that is the ITEM channel, filed under `ListItem` and not under `ListSchema`,
  the same shape as `tabs`."*

## What this changes downstream

The `the platform SHIPS the dialect it is being asked to refuse` block in
`scripts/__tests__/body-dialect-census.test.ts` used to name the two sites by
hand. It now reads the derived table, with two lit controls before it and its
handoff condition restated: when the table empties, that is the day objectui#6771
step 4 becomes landable — re-point the block, ⛔ do not delete the claim. Leg 4
proves the block is live rather than decorative.

## Verification

- `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/body-dialect-census.test.ts scripts/__tests__/body-dialect-producer-scan.test.ts` — **41 passed**, behind the seat lock.
- Gates green: `check:control-bytes`, `check:entry-guard`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:comment-mask-corpus`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:lint-rule-coverage`, `check:required-check-set`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask`, `check-changeset-presence`.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` over the three changed files, `--format json`: 3 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. The narrowing is sound for this diff: no rule in this repo's config is type-aware across files, and the diff touches no package source, so it cannot move any untouched file's verdict.
- ⚠️ NOT MEASURED: `check:node-esm-load` — it refused 17 of 37 entries on PROVENANCE, because the shared turbo cache replayed a sibling worktree's artifacts (`/home/user/objectui-issue-9889`) into this one. Environmental, and outside this diff, which touches no package source.
- ⛔ Draft on purpose. ⛔ Not flipped ready, ⛔ no auto-merge — landing is the seat's act.
